project: Story Cycling – Camps Bay hill and iPad visual beta
description: Polish the coastal scene; add a rideable low hill; prepare the first independent Unity iPad visual beta. Bluetooth bridge and store submission are not claimed.

userStories.title: Continuous coastal hill
userStories.description: Shared road, rider and camera climb eight metres with smooth joins; flat loop remains available
acceptanceCriteria: Full-lap route assertions pass at 0 m and 8 m relief
Slope does not exceed 6 percent; shoulder supports the raised asphalt
Editor visual review of coast, climb and descent
userStories.notes: Route and hill verified through trainer-experience full-lap review; eight metres, <6% grade.

userStories.title: iPad ride controls
userStories.description: Safe-area touch controls and mobile quality for the visual test build
acceptanceCriteria: Hold accelerate and brake; cruise and pause work without a keyboard
Focus loss releases held inputs and stops simulation
Mobile URP profile and landscape safe area checked
userStories.notes: Superseded by Vik: product is KICKR-driven. Touch acceleration must not ship; touch is only menus/pairing/pause.

userStories.title: Repeatable iPad export
userStories.description: One menu generates the new scene and an unsigned Xcode project
acceptanceCriteria: iPad-only ARM64 IL2CPP, Metal, landscape and unique bundle ID
Export succeeds with iOS Build Support or reports actionable missing module
Report separately: Unity export versus Xcode signing and actual device FPS
userStories.notes: Unity export successful 2026-09-18; signed Xcode/device validation remains separate.
